prompt: Which practices reduce Actions cost or duration? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Cheaper means less runner time and less stored data: caches shrink installs, shorter retention trims storage, and concurrency cancellation stops paying for runs the world no longer wants. Bigger machines and flat-rate assumptions move the bill the wrong way.

options.text: Restoring dependency caches instead of reinstalling every run
Shortening artifact retention to what audits actually need
Cancelling superseded runs for the same ref with a concurrency group
Choosing larger runners for every job regardless of workload
Treating every OS as billed at the same per-minute rate
